common.cancel.note: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

common.done.note: Button that closes a sheet or panel after changes.

common.close.note: Button or label that closes a window or panel.

common.back.note: Button that goes one step back.

common.undo.note: Button on a bar that undoes what just happened.

common.try_again.note: Button that repeats something that failed.

common.continue.note: Button that goes to the next step.

common.check.note: Button that tests a setting, such as a Brain or a server.

common.set_up.note: Button that starts setting something up.

common.settings.note: The app-wide settings, in menus and on buttons.

common.help.note: Spoken name of a small help icon that explains the control beside it.

common.needs_attention.note: Screen reader value of a settings section that has something to fix.

common.step.note: Screen reader name of one step of a short flow. The name is the step's own title.

common.action_working.note: Screen reader value of a button whose action is running.

common.action_done.note: Screen reader value of a button whose action just succeeded.

common.action_failed.note: Screen reader value of a button whose action just failed.
